summary: Take the same black point and read a Koch path; its partner follows a larger floor drawing. Trigger replaces every current segment once. Reconstruct the ordered position list, equilateral four-segment replacement and length sum using a separate next array. Predict fixed endpoints and increasing path length, then reverse the turn and try a sloping seed. The nearest-point reading locates a position along the curve; it does not measure hand travel. Compare the retained Sierpinski triangle before carrying replacement into the Menger cube.
